question: As per World Bank’s State of Social Protection Report 2025, during the COVID-19 pandemic, emergency social protection responses reached how many people in developing countries?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**1.7 billion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the **World Bank’s State of Social Protection Report 2025**, during the **COVID-19 pandemic**, emergency social protection measures were implemented to assist vulnerable populations in **developing countries**.
 
• These responses reached a significant number of **1.7 billion people**, showcasing the scale and urgency of the interventions.
 
• The efforts included a wide range of measures such as **cash transfers**, food distribution, and **subsidized healthcare services** to mitigate the economic and social impacts of the pandemic.
 
• The pandemic highlighted the critical need for robust **social protection systems** worldwide to address crises and support marginalized communities.
 
• This initiative was part of a global effort to strengthen **social safety nets** and prevent extreme poverty during unprecedented times.
 
• The data reflects the role of international organizations and governments in providing targeted support during emergencies.
 
• Such large-scale interventions underscore the importance of **collaboration** between governments, non-governmental organizations, and multilateral agencies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **World Bank**__

 __
 
• The **World Bank** is an international financial institution that provides loans and grants to the governments of low- and middle-income countries for the purpose of pursuing capital projects.
 
• It was established in **1944** and is headquartered in **Washington, D.C., USA**.
 
• The World Bank Group consists of five institutions, including the **International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)** and the **International Development Association (IDA)**.
 
• Its primary goal is to reduce **poverty** and support sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Social Protection**__
 
 
• **Social protection** refers to policies and programs designed to reduce poverty and vulnerability by promoting efficient labor markets, diminishing people's exposure to risks, and enhancing their capacity to manage economic and social risks.
 
• Examples of social protection measures include **unemployment benefits**, pensions, and **disaster relief programs**.
 
• During the **COVID-19 pandemic**, social protection measures were crucial for providing immediate relief to populations affected by lockdowns and economic slowdowns.
